newsitem.title: USA: Essex Property files $60 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Essex Property files $60 mln shelf offer.

text.p: Essex Property Trust Inc said Thursday it filed a shelf registration with Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $60 million in preferred and common stock, despositary shares and warrants.
When combined with previous registrations, Essex will have a combined total offer of $102,442,500, the filing said.
The Palo Alto, Calif-based company intends to invest the proceeds in the operating partnership, the filing said.
The partnership then intends to use the proceeds for general corporate purposes including the acquisition and development of multi-family residential properties and the repayment of debt.

Essex is a self-administered and self-managed equity REIT (real estate investment trust) that was formed in 1994 to continue and expand the real estate investment and management operations conducted by Essex Property Corp sinc 1971.
